components.name: Pagination Button (legacy — migrate to shared Button)
components.description: Hand-rolled prev/next button in News.svelte and Tutorials.svelte. Confirmed drift, not a sanctioned pattern — replace with the shared @computational-biology-aachen/design Button component when touched. Shown as-is (neutral variant from News.svelte) for reference only.
components.css: .ds-btn-pagination { transition: var(--transition); cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--color-text); border-radius: 0.25rem; background-color: var(--color-text); padding: 0.75rem 2rem; color: var(--color-bg); font-size: 1rem; } .ds-btn-pagination:not([disabled]):hover { transform: scale(1.05); box-shadow: inset 0em 0em 0em 10em rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.125); } .ds-btn-pagination:active { transform: scale(1); box-shadow: inset 5px 5px 10px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); } .ds-btn-pagination:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; border: 1px solid var(--color-surface); background-color: var(--color-surface); }

narrative.overview: This site has no visual system of its own. Every color, typeface, spacing value, and component comes from @computational-biology-aachen/design, imported via tokens.css and the shared Svelte components. That package's own DESIGN.md is the canonical spec for Colors, Layout, Elevation & Depth, and Shapes. This file records only two confirmed drifts from that canonical spec, both flagged for migration rather than documented as sanctioned exceptions.
keyCharacteristics: No local color, spacing, radius, or layout tokens; app.css only sets base html/body properties from imported CSS variables plus a .katex-display margin reset.
Two confirmed drifts from the upstream spec, both flagged for migration rather than documented as intentional exceptions.
No other local component library: all Card, Section, Button, Text, etc. usage is the shared package's components used as-is.

rules.name: The One-Typeface Migration Rule
rules.body: The Quicksand hero treatment in Home.svelte is tech debt, not a pattern. Don't extend Quicksand to any other heading or component. Migrate .hero-line to Space Grotesk and drop the Quicksand Google Fonts family from src/app.html when Home.svelte is next touched.

dos: Do treat pkg-js/design's DESIGN.md as the canonical source for colors, layout, elevation, shapes, and every component other than the two drifts recorded here.
Do migrate the News.svelte/Tutorials.svelte pagination buttons to the shared Button component the next time either file is touched.
Do migrate Home.svelte's .hero-line off Quicksand to Space Grotesk (and remove the Quicksand <link> in src/app.html) the next time the hero is touched.
donts: Don't copy the Quicksand hero treatment to any other component — it is drift being phased out, not an approved second display face.
Don't copy the hand-rolled pagination button styles to any new component — use the shared Button directly for any new prev/next or action-button UI.
Don't re-derive colors, spacing, or radius values locally for this site; import them from @computational-biology-aachen/design/tokens.css as app.css already does.
